physicalAnchorReview.method: Manually observed center of ribcage immediately behind front shoulder, not silhouette or tail bounds center. Landmarks measured individually on 1400x700 diagnostic source views with 350px cells, converted through actual source cell offsets to 1774x887 nominal coordinates. Grounded support uses complete pose padded bottom (three-pixel extraction guard) visually checked against planted limbs or collapsed body. Confidence medium, uncertainty 10 source pixels. Prowler airborne attack poses 3-5 use the preceding grounded anticipation floor y=384 as an explicit projected support-plane estimate, preserving authored flight height; this does not certify animation trajectory or runtime root motion.
